environments.name: Dry
environments.description: No suitable surface water. A Sulan colony needs a sealed harbor.

environments.name: Open Ocean
environments.description: Water without the shallow mineral-rich shelves needed for native Sulan habitation.

environments.name: Shelf Sea
environments.description: Shallow mineral-rich water suitable for a native Sulan colony.

species.name: Harl
species.description: Restless, short-lived scholars whose schools preserve the work of each generation. Fast recovery and small settlement launches favor busy, growing communities.

species.name: Peldra
species.description: Long-lived, broad-handed estate builders with formidable appetites. Support a small, skilled workforce and it can carry powerful workshops and laboratories.

species.name: Sulan
species.description: Shark-like aliens at home in shallow, mineral-rich shelf seas. Native expeditions build roomy shelf colonies; costlier harbor kits open other worlds in sealed habitats.

species.name: Wenth
species.description: Each colony is one vast living body; its population units are functional lobes. Skilled work comes easily, but a body must mature to its current capacity before sending a daughter seed.
